title: President Names Jay Clayton to Lead New White House AI Group
summary:
President Donald Trump said on Sunday that Jay Clayton has a new job. Clayton is the director of national intelligence. Now he is also the White House "AI czar." Trump shared the news on Truth Social. He said Clayton will lead a new group called the "Super Intelligence Force." Trump wrote that it will "ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence."

The group will work with many people, such as consumers, religious organizations and companies that run important systems like power and water. Trump named other members too. They are Andrew Ferguson, Scott Kupor and Emil Michael.

Some tech leaders have warned that fast-moving AI could be risky. Trump has mostly brushed those warnings aside. On Tuesday, he met with AI company leaders at the White House. He said several of them signed a voluntary agreement. It includes reviews of their work.

No one knows yet what Clayton's new job will mean for the AI industry. Congress has not passed a broad law about AI. Last month, Clayton said super intelligence is a national security issue.
why_it_matters: AI is a fast-changing technology that affects many people, so choices about who leads the government's work on it can matter to families and schools.
